scripts.build: npm run build -w @aim/contracts && npm run build -w @aim/api && npm run build -w @aim/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n contracts,api,web -c gray,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @aim/contracts" "npm run dev -w @aim/api" "npm run dev -w @aim/web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @aim/contracts && npm run test -w @aim/api
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run build -w @aim/contracts && npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:harden && npm run db:seed
